info.description: Authentication and authorization REST API (JWT access + refresh, OTP, RBAC, registration invites).
info.title: Auth service API

get.description: Returns 204 when the process accepts HTTP.

parameters.description: Must match csrf_token cookie (set after login)
parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token

200.description: otp_sent indicates whether OTP email was sent
Includes csrf_token for subsequent CSRF-protected calls

post.description: Requires X-CSRF-Token; sends refresh cookie if present (REFRESH_COOKIE_NAME, default refresh_token).
Requires HttpOnly refresh cookie (name from REFRESH_COOKIE_NAME, default refresh_token) and X-CSRF-Token matching the csrf_token cookie.
Creates an account; invite must be valid and may lock the registration email.

400.description: Invalid JSON, password policy, duplicate login/email, …

get.description: Returns claims for valid access or service tokens. Response header X-Token-Stale: 1 when signing key rotated.

parameters.description: Target user and level (member or role_admin)
parameters.name: body

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and the access JWT.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
